mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 3.5% triggers a negative feedback loop where investor confidence wanes, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods of rising UNRATE above 3.5% are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the effect diminishes in subsequent months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and rise in GDP growth (GDPC1) creates a dual accommodative signal, amplifying investor confidence and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS falls > 0.5% AND GDPC1 rises > 100 in 3 months
failure_condition: The 60-day returns do not show a significant positive correlation with the combined signal (p > 0.05 in a t-test) or the effect reverses in the subsequent month.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sustained drop in CPIAUCSL below 2% triggers a deflationary expectation that reduces risk premiums, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns fail to rise significantly above baseline during deflationary periods (p > 0.05) or the effect is reversed in the following quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing activity, fostering optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns do not correlate significantly with INDPRO trends (p > 0.05) or the effect wanes in subsequent months.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden surge in GDP growth (GDPC1) above 22,500 triggers a speculative buying frenzy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns fail to show a significant positive spike (p > 0.05) or the effect dissipates by day 10.

mechanism_narrative: A convergence of falling unemployment (UNRATE) and rising employment (PAYEMS) signals labor market strength, boosting equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls > 0.2pp AND PAYEMS rises > 50 in 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day returns show no significant positive correlation with the combined signal (p > 0.05) or the effect reverses in the next month.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery phase, a sustained rise in RSAFS above 600 million indicates rebuilding demand, prompting positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns fail to rise significantly above baseline during rebuilding periods (p > 0.05) or the effect fades in subsequent quarters.
